name: Click the place on the map
summary: A place name appears; tap where it is on a blank map before time runs out.
core_loop: read the name → tap the map → it highlights right or wrong → next name
rules: three tries per name, then it's shown
social_hooks: race friends on the same map
example_prompts: quiz me on the countries of africa
click the US states on a map
notes: Taps resolve to a country with geo_map's geo_place_at(pointer). Taps resolve to a country with geo_map's geo_place_at(pointer).

name: Label the diagram
summary: Drag labels onto the right parts of a diagram (a cell, an engine, a skeleton).
core_loop: pick a label → drag it to a part → it snaps if right → finish the diagram
rules: each label fits exactly one spot
social_hooks: study buddies race on the same diagram
example_prompts: label the parts of a cell
anatomy quiz for my bio class
label the parts of a guitar

name: Fill the table
summary: Type items into a fixed table layout (elements, presidents by term, planets by order) until every cell is full.
core_loop: type an answer → it drops into its cell → keep going → the table fills
social_hooks: co-op fill with your study group
example_prompts: name every element in the periodic table
fill in the presidents in order

name: Countries and capitals
summary: Match each country to its capital as fast as possible.
core_loop: A country appears; pick or type its capital as fast as you can, building a streak until one miss ends the round
example_prompts: match the country to the capital
notes: Capitals come from the geo pack (geo.quiz.ask = capital). Capitals come from the geo pack (geo.quiz.ask = capital).

name: Vocabulary cards
summary: A word appears; pick or type its meaning; missed words come back sooner.
core_loop: see a word → answer its meaning → missed words return → master the set
rules: a card is mastered after two right in a row
social_hooks: share a deck with your class

name: Translate the phrase
summary: Translate short phrases between two languages by tapping word tiles in order.
core_loop: Read a short phrase in one language and tap word tiles in the right order to build its translation, then check and move on
social_hooks: streaks with friends learning the same language

name: Listen and pick
summary: Hear a sound (a word, a bird call, an instrument) and pick what it is.
core_loop: Play a short sound such as a spoken word, bird call or instrument, then pick what it is from a few options; replays cost points
example_prompts: guess the bird by its call

name: Balance the equation
summary: Adjust coefficients until both sides of a chemical equation balance.
core_loop: See an unbalanced chemical equation and tap each coefficient up or down until atoms match on both sides, then check
rules: atoms of each element must match on both sides

name: Date the event
summary: Slide a year marker to when an event happened; closer is better.
core_loop: Read a historical event, slide a marker along a timeline to the year you think it happened, and score by how close you are
example_prompts: history timeline quiz for ap us history
guess the year of the battle

name: Who painted it
summary: See an artwork and pick the artist or movement.
core_loop: See an original artwork in a style, pick the movement or era it belongs to, then read a short fact before the next one

name: Connect the stars
summary: Draw lines between stars to form the named constellation.
core_loop: Read a constellation's name and draw lines between stars in order to trace it on the sky map, then check the shape
rules: lines must match the known pattern

name: Type the name from the outline
summary: See an outline or flag; type the name with fuzzy spelling.
core_loop: See a country's outline or flag and type its name; near-miss spellings count, and a hint reveals the first letter
social_hooks: daily outline shared in a Group
example_prompts: type the country from its shape
notes: Outlines from the geo pack; the pack's aliases go into the answer bank. Outlines from the geo pack; the pack's aliases go into the answer bank.

name: Build the timeline
summary: Drag a full set of events into chronological order, then check.
core_loop: drag events into order → check → wrong ones flash → fix and recheck
rules: the whole order is checked at once
social_hooks: study groups race the same set
example_prompts: put world war 2 events in order

name: Sort into categories
summary: Sort items into the right category (mammal vs reptile, metal vs nonmetal).
core_loop: An item appears, such as a whale or a metal; drag it into the correct category bin and keep going until time runs out
rules: each item belongs to one bin
example_prompts: sort animals into mammals and reptiles

name: Fill in the blank
summary: Read a sentence from a lesson and fill the missing key term.
core_loop: Read a sentence from a lesson with a key term removed, type or pick the missing term, and see the full sentence after
social_hooks: share a set from your notes
example_prompts: fill in the blanks from my biology notes
turn my notes into a quiz

name: Adaptive difficulty quiz
summary: Each right answer makes the next question harder; wrong answers ease off; ends with a level.
core_loop: Answer questions one at a time; each right answer raises the difficulty and each miss lowers it, ending with your level
example_prompts: how good am I at geography

name: Point to the body part
summary: A part is named; tap it on the body diagram.
core_loop: A body part is named; tap where it is on a labeled-free diagram, get feedback on how close you were, then the next part
rules: taps must land inside the part
example_prompts: point to the bones in the hand

name: Name the note or chord
summary: See or hear a note, interval or chord and name it.
core_loop: See or hear a note, interval or chord, pick its name from the options, and build a streak across a short set

name: What does this code print
summary: Read a short code snippet and pick what it outputs.
core_loop: Read a short code snippet, pick what it prints from four options, then see a line-by-line explanation of why
example_prompts: python quiz what does this print

name: Convert the unit
summary: Convert a measurement into another unit within a tolerance.
core_loop: Read a measurement and type its value in another unit; answers within the tolerance score, closer answers score more

name: Fix the sentence
summary: Tap the error in a sentence and choose the fix.
core_loop: Read a sentence, tap the word or phrase that's wrong, then pick the correct fix from a few choices before moving on
social_hooks: teacher shares a set with the class
example_prompts: find the mistake in the sentence

name: Science myth or fact
summary: Decide if a science claim is true; see the explanation.
core_loop: Read a science claim, swipe or tap true or false, then read a one-line explanation of the real answer

name: Name the picture in another language
summary: See a picture; type or pick its word in the language you're learning.
core_loop: See a picture and type or pick its word in the language you're learning; misses come back later in the set
example_prompts: learn french food words with pictures

name: Match term to definition
summary: Match each term to its definition by dragging lines.
core_loop: pick a term → drag to a definition → lock in → finish the set
social_hooks: share a glossary set with classmates

name: Build the flag
summary: Assemble a flag from colors and shapes to match a country.
core_loop: Read a country's name, then pick colors, stripes and symbols to assemble its flag, and check it against the real layout
example_prompts: build the flag of each country

name: Hear it, spell it
summary: Hear a word with its sentence, then type its spelling.
core_loop: Hear a word read aloud with an example sentence, type its spelling, and replay if needed; misses end the round
example_prompts: hear the word and spell it

name: Build the formula
summary: Combine element tiles with subscripts to build a named compound.
core_loop: Read a compound's name and place element tiles with the right subscripts to build its formula, then check it

name: Math facts drill
summary: Answer arithmetic facts as fast as you can.
core_loop: Arithmetic facts appear one after another; type each answer as fast as you can while the pace speeds up

name: Name the landmark
summary: See a landmark photo and name it or its city.
core_loop: See an original illustration of a landmark, name it or its city, then see where it is on a map before the next

name: Make a memory hook
summary: Build a silly sentence to remember a list, then recall the list from it.
core_loop: read the list → write a hook sentence → later recall the list → check
rules: the hook's first letters match the list

name: Pick the best decision
summary: Read a short scenario and pick the best next step; see the reasoning.
core_loop: Read a short scenario, choose the best next action from a few options, then see what happens and why it was right or wrong

name: Order the process steps
summary: Drag the steps of a process (mitosis, the water cycle) into order.
core_loop: Read a process name like the water cycle, drag its steps into the right order, then check and see any steps out of place
example_prompts: steps to make bread in order

name: Read and answer
summary: Read a short passage, then answer questions about it.
core_loop: Read a short passage, then answer three to five questions about it without scrolling back, and see your score

name: How far apart
summary: Guess the distance between two places; closer is better.
core_loop: Two places are named; slide to guess the distance between them, then see the real distance on a map and score by closeness
example_prompts: how far is paris from rome

name: Which has more
summary: Pick which of two foods has more calories, sugar or protein.
core_loop: Two foods appear; pick which has more calories, sugar or protein, then see both numbers and continue the streak

name: Road signs and rules
summary: See a road sign or driving situation and pick what it means.
core_loop: See a road sign or a driving situation and pick what it means or what to do, then read the rule before the next one
social_hooks: friends studying for the permit test

name: Name the company
summary: See a stock ticker or logo and name the company.
core_loop: See a ticker symbol and type or pick the company it belongs to, with a streak bonus for consecutive right answers
example_prompts: guess the company from the ticker

name: Match the sign
summary: See a hand sign and pick the letter or word.
core_loop: See a hand sign drawn or animated and pick the letter or word it means; misses come back later in the set
social_hooks: practice with a friend learning ASL
example_prompts: match the sign to the word

name: Decode Morse
summary: Hear or see Morse code and type the letters.
core_loop: Hear or see a Morse code message and type the letters it spells; replays are allowed but cost points

name: Name the plant
summary: See a plant or leaf and pick its name.
core_loop: See an illustration of a plant or leaf, pick its name from the options, then read one fact about it

name: Count the coins
summary: Count the coins and bills shown and type the total.
core_loop: See a set of coins and bills, type the total amount, and check; harder rounds mix more denominations
example_prompts: count the money game for kids

name: Read the clock
summary: Read an analog clock and type or pick the time.
core_loop: Read an analog clock face and type or pick the time it shows; later rounds need exact minutes

name: This week's news quiz
summary: Answer questions about this week's headlines.
core_loop: Answer multiple-choice questions about this week's news, with a short source summary shown after each answer
example_prompts: did you follow the news this week

name: Finish the famous quote
summary: Complete famous historical quotes or speeches.
core_loop: Read the start of a famous public-domain quote or speech and type or pick how it ends
example_prompts: who said it and finish it

name: Name the missing ingredient
summary: See a dish and its ingredients with one missing; name it.
core_loop: See a dish and its ingredient list with one missing, then type or pick the missing ingredient

name: Know the rules
summary: Read a game situation and pick the correct ruling.
core_loop: Read a described play in a sport or game and pick the correct ruling, then read the rule that applies
social_hooks: fans argue it out in a Group

name: Sort into eras
summary: Sort creatures, inventions or artworks into the right era.
core_loop: Creatures, inventions or artworks appear one at a time; drop each into the era it belongs to on a timeline
rules: each item belongs to one era
example_prompts: which era is this invention from

name: Rank by a fact
summary: Rank items by a fact (planets by size, countries by population).
core_loop: Drag a set of items into rank order by a fact such as planet size or population, check, and fix any out of place

name: Do the steps in order
summary: Tap the steps of a procedure (CPR, recovery position) in order under time.
core_loop: Read an emergency situation and tap the steps of the right procedure in order before the timer, with feedback on each step

name: Match the number to the rule
summary: Match numbered items (amendments, commandments, laws) to what they say.
core_loop: See a numbered item from a list such as amendments or laws, and pick what it says from several options
example_prompts: match the amendments to their rights

name: Guess the element from clues
summary: Clues reveal one at a time (atomic number range, state at room temp); guess early.
core_loop: Clues about an element appear one by one, such as its group or state at room temperature; guess early to score more

name: Which country is lit up?
summary: A country lights up on a real world (or continent) map and you pick its name from neighbouring countries before the bar runs out.
core_loop: see the lit-up country → pick its name from three or four neighbours → next country
rules: the wrong choices are the country's nearest neighbours
win: name every country in the round
social_hooks: the same map for the whole Group, best score on the board
a map of the countries a Group has visited
content_needs: places from the geo pack (picked or named)
example_prompts: trivia geography game with maps featured on the screen
name the highlighted country on a map of Africa
which European country is lit up
notes: Kevin's prompt #7. Example game: authoring/content/geo/examples/map_spotter.json. Places, outlines and coordinates come from the geo content pack (map_geometry, Natural Earth), never from Muse.

name: Name it from its outline
aliases: guess the state from its shape
guess the country from its shape
summary: A country's or US state's outline appears alone, big and filled in; pick its name from its neighbours before the bar runs out.
core_loop: see the outline → pick the place from four neighbours → next outline
rules: the outline has no map around it
the wrong choices are its nearest neighbours
win: name every outline in the round
social_hooks: a US Group plays its own states
challenge a friend to beat your shapes score
content_needs: places from the geo pack (countries or US states)
example_prompts: guess the US state from its shape
name the state from its outline for our road trip group
notes: Multiple-choice sibling of spell_the_country. Example game: authoring/content/geo/examples/state_shapes.json. Places, outlines and coordinates come from the geo content pack (map_geometry, Natural Earth), never from Muse.
